text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Shuka Sho drew near—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—...Phew. Ikuno-san, thank you so much for 
joining me for personal training today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I should be the one thanking you. I 
learned a great deal from it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if that is the case, then it's fine, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...McQueen-san and I each have the Shuka 
Sho and the Kikuka Sho ahead of us.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(We both devoted ourselves to our goals 
over the summer. I personally feel that 
I've leveled up considerably, but—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(McQueen is heading into the Kikuka Sho 
having undergone an even more staggering 
evolution—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...No, that's not it. It's not growth. In 
McQueen-san's case, this is her natural 
talent, her true ability.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(It was merely that due to unforeseen leg 
trouble, her talent was suppressed, and 
she lost her chance to run in the Spring 
Classics—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(She overcame that adversity with an 
indomitable spirit, and now the time for 
her to shine has simply arrived.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Good luck in the 'Kikuka Sho'.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe all of McQueen-san's hard 
work will surely lead to great results.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...That is my line, Ikuno-san. Best of 
luck in the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If it's you, I am certain you will be 
able to deliver a magnificent run even in 
the final battle of the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was emboldened by that run, which is 
what led me to take on the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
......Then, let us bless each other's 
endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and with all my heartfelt 
encouragement—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――The hoofprints chasing the maidens' 
crowns gather here now. The final stop of 
the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho. Post time 
is steadily drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So it's finally time, huh... With top 
Umamusume getting injured and all, this 
year's been pretty turbulent too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I know, right. I just hope no one gets 
hurt in the Shuka Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even though the Shuka Sho is finally 
here, my heart is surprisingly at peace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it seemed the same held true for Ikuno 
Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The management shared between Ikuno Dictus 
and myself will surely bring out her full 
potential today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And even if the worst should happen— Ikuno 
Dictus and self-maintenance will surely 
protect the future ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This isn't wishful thinking. It's a 
resolve, and a vow.
choice_data_list: Go and give it your all

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Without fail, I shall deliver the 
culmination of the Triple Tiara and carve 
out even greater hoofprints ahead.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Running longer than anyone—
choice_data_list: In order to win more than anyone else

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The autumn showdown for the final crown 
begins—
